title: George R.R. Martin - Westeros
use_cases: Use when managing a large fantasy world with numerous characters and interwoven plotlines
Configure to keep track of births, deaths, marriages and lineage across continents
Implement to record political alliances, betrayals, and shifting loyalties over time
Use when mapping geography with travel times for realistic pacing
Implement to log character locations at all times for massive casts
Configure to schedule seasonal variations like years-long winters in plot planning
content:
What Martin tracks: • Complex family trees with births, deaths, marriages • Political alliances and betrayals • Geography with travel times • Seasonal variations (years-long winters) • Character locations at all times (especially with massive cast)

Challenges: With 20+ POV characters across multiple continents, tracking who knows what when is massive undertaking. Martin uses extensive notes and timeline software.

Lesson: The more complex your world and cast, the more essential rigorous documentation becomes. Don't trust memory—track everything.
